title: Modeling and Control for UAV with Off-center Slung Load
plant_model: single multirotor with off-center suspension point
control_method: cascade: outer load velocity, middle suspension-point acceleration swing control, inner off-center attitude control
required_state: UAV pose/velocity, swing angles/rates, load/tension-related states
control_output: load velocity, swing angle, UAV attitude/thrust/torque
stability_claim: local exponential stability via Lyapunov arguments
experiment_type: simulation, ground experiment, real flight experiment
selection_reason: preserves suspension-point acceleration regulates swing and cascade structure; maps five-link swing to causal equivalent pendulum

title: ES-HPC-MPC: Exponentially Stable Hybrid Perception Constrained MPC for Quadrotor with Suspended Payloads
plant_model: quadrotor with taut/slack hybrid cable dynamics
payload_model: suspended payload with cable mode transitions
control_method: ES-CLF/CBF constrained MPC with hybrid-aware state estimation
required_state: full vehicle/payload state, cable mode, onboard perception state
control_output: trajectory tracking with payload camera FoV constraint
stability_claim: exponential convergence and perception safety claims under hybrid modes
selection_reason: requires slack-to-taut hybrid model and camera FoV constraint absent from frozen five-link plant

title: SEP-NMPC: Safety Enhanced Passivity-Based Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for a UAV Slung Payload System
plant_model: single quadrotor, point-mass payload, massless rigid cable
control_method: passivity-constrained NMPC with HOCBF obstacle safety
required_state: full state including quadrotor pose, payload swing, velocities, obstacle geometry
control_output: shaped translational input with passivity and clearance constraints
stability_claim: asymptotic convergence and forward-invariant safety set claims
selection_reason: core proof depends on point-mass/massless-cable and obstacle HOCBF assumptions absent from benchmark

title: On dynamic performance control for a quadrotor-slung-load system with unknown load mass
required_state: load position and cable direction errors plus velocities
control_output: load trajectory and cable-direction tracking inputs
stability_claim: prescribed performance / trajectory tracking claim; exact proof contract requires full paper implementation audit
experiment_type: simulation evidence reported in publisher record
selection_reason: unknown-mass adaptation changes the estimation/tuning contract and is not needed for the frozen plant

title: Composite Perturbation-Rejection Trajectory-Tracking Control for a Quadrotor-Slung Load System
control_method: backstepping plus command filter and multivariable finite-time disturbance observer
selection_reason: observer and full XYZ interface would require a separate controller contract and is not the closest fair x-channel adaptation

title: Agile and Cooperative Aerial Manipulation of a Cable-Suspended Load
venue/status: Science Robotics 10(107), eadu8015; author page and preprint reviewed
plant_model: multiple quadrotors with coupled whole-body dynamics
control_method: online whole-body kinodynamic planning with receding-horizon tracking and cable-tension compensation
stability_claim: experimental agility/robustness evidence; no direct single-UAV five-link equivalence
selection_reason: multi-quadrotor planning and cooperative cable-tension interface are outside the frozen single-UAV five-link benchmark
